about.en:
The State Silk Museum in Tbilisi runs an unpaid internship programme once a year. Interns work in one of four departments: collections, education, exhibition or library. The programme is meant for students of museology and related fields, and finishes with a certificate.

There is no application form on the page; candidates contact the museum by email or phone. Call details are announced on the museum's website and social media.

about.en:
EPAM Campus runs a Cloud & DevOps internship at EPAM Lab for candidates in Georgia. It is online, taught in English, and takes roughly 2.5 to 3 months at 20-30 hours a week. It is free, and the page does not mention a stipend.

Selection has four steps: register with a CV, take an English test and technical assessment, complete a Docker practical task, then a technical interview. Required skills include Git, hypervisors and networking, Linux, Docker, and Bash and Python scripting.

en: Real EPAM Lab training in Cloud and DevOps
Open to final-year students and graduates in Georgia

eligibility.en: Citizen of Georgia, or a permanent resident who can legally work there; final-year student, graduate or career changer; 18+; English B1 or higher; working knowledge of Git, Linux, Docker, networking and Bash/Python. Georgian C1+ is a plus.
